entities.summary: Peter Rasmus Krag was a Norwegian engineer captain in the Norwegian Army, chief-of-roads and politician. He sat as a member of the Parliament of Norway for several terms. His two brothers, Hans Hagerup Krag and Ole Herman Johannes Krag were also engineers, as was their great uncle Rasmus Krag
